The Developer Journey

My development journey began out of pure curiosity about how computers, operating systems, and programs operate under the hood. As an entirely self-taught developer, I learned not by reading abstract theory in lecture halls, but by compiling code, breaking systems down to their primitives, and building real tools that solve daily computing problems.

Over time, this curiosity grew into designing comprehensive standalone applications — from exploring Chromium internals to build Xtreme AI Browser with sandboxed identities, to writing background task utilities like Awaken, to exploring autonomous assistant architectures in Rafail AI.

Progression Timeline

1Started with relentless curiosity about how software, operating systems, and automation logic work under the hood.
2Taught myself modern programming paradigms by building real desktop utilities, scripts, and software experiments.
3Ventured into AI integrations, developing custom AI companions (Rafail AI) and specialized browsers (Xtreme AI Browser).
4Continually crafting and shipping independent software designed with clean dark aesthetics and rock-solid privacy.
